amendment: Replace D2/D3 with Top20-only symbol counts greater than zero, while preserving the holding-overlap checks and all cache hashes.
effect_on_rule_or_returns: No effect on the R350 ensemble rule, cache inputs, costs, gates or any return calculation. No candidate portfolio return has been computed.
issue: The original breadth checks required the union of Top10 and Top20 symbols to exceed the Top20 symbol count. When Top10 holdings are a subset of Top20, the union necessarily equals Top20, so the check is structurally invalid rather than an economic failure.
